title: PR 59 duplicates PR 43 in mimi-room-policy; one should be closed
description:
Found 2026-11-23 while opening the cascade PR, by listing the repo's open
PRs before posting a third one into the same section.

ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy#43 "Allow parent-dependent rooms with the
parent's members", branch MarkAtwood:issue-40, has been open since
2026-10-21. Its body: "A parent-dependent room's participants now need
only be a subset of the parent's, not a strict subset ... Parent-dependent
rooms are also exempt from the one-fixed-membership-room-per-set rule."

That is exactly what I opened as #59 today, both halves of it. #59 is a
duplicate of a PR that was already there, and both say "Fixes #40" /
"Closes #40".

MY ERROR: I checked issue #40 before writing #59 and did not list the
open PULL REQUESTS, so I did not see that Mark had already proposed the
fix a month earlier. The lesson generalises past this repo: list the open
PRs, not only the issues, before proposing a change upstream.

WHAT TO DO, Mark's call: close #59 as a duplicate of #43 and leave the
older one, which is the usual courtesy and keeps the discussion where any
earlier review sits; or close #43 and keep #59 if its wording is better.
The two differ in wording only. Related in the same area and NOT
duplicates: #44 (who enforces the single-room rule), #45
(canCreateSubgroup, canJoinFromParent), and the new #60 (who performs the
cascade).

Nothing in mimid depends on which survives: decision mimid-1wgh.110 cites
#40 and #59, and the code comments cite #59. If #59 is closed, those
pointers should move to #43.
